notes.title: Audiobook DLC and 100 Keys Giveaway
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27092674/45cc5329cf281493ed4c56a11a9c2d6f4428b35e.jpg[/img]

Santa PoRovoz doesn’t say Ho-ho-ho. He says Hu-hu-hu. For Humanity! 

Today we are excited to present you, our fellow earthlings, a free DLC for Earth Liberation - The Novel. It’s an audiobook written by an award-winning author that will help you dive deeper into the game’s backstory. It reveals a lot about the key characters as they witness the beginning of the Khraster invasion of Earth.

Enjoy! And get ready for a next part of The Novel - it’s already on its way.

To warm up this winter holiday with battle fever, we are also running a 24 hour giveaway on IndieDB with 100 Earth Liberation keys up for grabs. The giveaway is already live, don't miss your chance.

Good luck and best wishes for 2017!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/569820/]Audiobook DLC[/url]

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/giveaways/earthliberation]IndieDB Giveaway[/url]

notes.title: ...Presents on the way...
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27092674/ade271705d3e43565d3ec46e901bc5027997277b.jpg[/img]

Happy Holidays everyone! Santa PoRovoz is preparing some presents for you. 

On December 27th we are launching a [b]free DLC[/b] for Earth Liberation and on December 28th an epic [b]giveaway of 100 Steam keys[/b] on [url=http://www.indiedb.com/giveaways/earth-liberation] IndieDB[/url]!

Stay tuned for more details to be announced in the coming days. We hope you are enjoying your Holidays and we are eagerly expecting to see you soon on the battlefield, leading your troops to destroy the [b]Khrasters[/b]!

notes.title: Earth Liberation Release Date - December 15th, 2016
notes.notes:
We will be releasing Earth Liberation as an Early Access game on December 15th, 2016. 

We have also launched a [url=https://headtalker.com/campaigns/earth-liberation-hits-steam/] Headtalker Campaign[/url]. It would appreciated very much if you could support us and share the link with your friends. 

Looking forward to the launch and receiving feedback from the community.
